_comment: Copy to dashboard.config.json at the ROOT of the private data repository (tus4/data1). Every key is optional; keys starting with '_' are ignored. Unknown keys fail the build.
_mode: "rows" = publish data rows (capped) plus statistics and charts; "aggregates" = statistics and charts only, never rows.
title: 데이터 대시보드
_auto_exclude_sensitive: Columns whose header contains one of sensitive_patterns, or whose values look like e-mail / phone / resident-id, are dropped automatically. List a header in allow_columns to publish it anyway.
